title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning and audit logging enhancements
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 resources and augment audit logs for KMS-related operations. Operational tightening only; no public API contract changes.
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated environments require guarantees that KMS keys referenced by RBAC v2 policies are pinned to specific regions and that all KMS operations surface richer audit metadata. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at policy evaluation time and expands audit logging to include key residency, requester identity, and policy decision context. Summary of changes: 1) RBAC evaluator: add kms_region constraint check and policy validation time warnings; 2) KMS integration layer: attach region and key-residency metadata to all KMS calls and propagate through audit events; 3) Audit pipeline: new audit fields (kms_key_region, kms_key_id, policy_version, decision_reason) and schema migration; 4) CLI/console improvements: validation errors surfaced in policy editor, and docs + migration guide; 5) Tests: unit and integration tests for enforcement, and end-to-end smoke tests in staging. Backwards compatibility: Existing policies that do not specify kms_region remain allowed but will emit warnings during validation; orgs with enforce-kms-residency label will have enforcement turned on by default after rollout. Rollout plan: feature gated behind rbac_v2_kms_residency flag; staged rollout to Dedicated customers, opt-in for Hosted first 2 weeks, then org-level opt-in before enforcement. Monitoring: added metrics rbac.kms_region_violation and audit.events.kms_enriched_count. Linear/Jira: ENG-4521 tracks core work, SEC-112 tracks audit schema. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of enforcement checks - [x] Audit pipeline schema and migration script - [x] Console validation + docs - [x] Unit/integration tests - [x] CI passing and security scan passed
